mapper.select: select branch_id branchId, workbook_id workbookId, branch_name branchName, head_commit_id headCommitId, owner_user_id ownerUserId, visibility, status, version from ai_workbook_branch where workbook_id=#{workbookId} and owner_user_id=#{userId} and branch_name='main' and status='active' limit 1

select branch_id branchId, workbook_id workbookId, branch_name branchName, head_commit_id headCommitId, owner_user_id ownerUserId, visibility, status, version from ai_workbook_branch where workbook_id=#{workbookId} and branch_id=#{branchId} and owner_user_id=#{userId} and status='active'

select branch_id branchId, branch_name branchName, head_commit_id headCommitId, visibility, status, version, created_time createdTime, update_time updateTime from ai_workbook_branch where workbook_id=#{workbookId} and owner_user_id=#{userId} order by case when branch_name='main' then 0 else 1 end, created_time

select branch_id branchId, workbook_id workbookId, branch_name branchName, head_commit_id headCommitId, owner_user_id ownerUserId, visibility, status, version from ai_workbook_branch where workbook_id=#{workbookId} and branch_name=#{branchName} and owner_user_id=#{userId} and status='active' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into ai_workbook_branch (workbook_id, branch_name, head_commit_id, owner_user_id, visibility, status, version, created_time, update_time) values (#{workbookId}, #{branchName}, #{headCommitId}, #{ownerUserId}, 'private', 'active', 0, now(3), now(3))
mapper.select: select coalesce(max(commit_no), 0) + 1 from ai_workbook_commit where workbook_id=#{workbookId}

select commit_id commitId, workbook_id workbookId, branch_id branchId, parent_commit_id parentCommitId, commit_no commitNo, commit_message commitMessage, source, author_user_id authorUserId, operation_id operationId, before_hash beforeHash, after_hash afterHash, snapshot_id snapshotId, created_time createdTime from ai_workbook_commit where workbook_id=#{workbookId} and operation_id=#{operationId}

select c.commit_id commitId, c.workbook_id workbookId, c.branch_id branchId, c.parent_commit_id parentCommitId, c.second_parent_id secondParentId, c.commit_no commitNo, c.commit_message commitMessage, c.source, c.author_user_id authorUserId, c.author_name authorName, c.operation_id operationId, c.action_schema_version actionSchemaVersion, c.planned_actions_json plannedActionsJson, c.executed_changes_json executedChangesJson, c.inverse_changes_json inverseChangesJson, c.diff_summary_json diffSummaryJson, c.knowledge_refs_json knowledgeRefsJson, c.data_context_json dataContextJson, c.execution_context_json executionContextJson, c.before_hash beforeHash, c.after_hash afterHash, c.validation_json validationJson, c.snapshot_id snapshotId, c.created_time createdTime from ai_workbook_commit c join ai_workbook w on w.workbook_id=c.workbook_id where c.workbook_id=#{workbookId} and c.commit_id=#{commitId} and w.user_id=#{userId}

select c.commit_id commitId, c.branch_id branchId, c.parent_commit_id parentCommitId, c.commit_no commitNo, c.commit_message commitMessage, c.source, c.author_name authorName, c.before_hash beforeHash, c.after_hash afterHash, c.snapshot_id snapshotId, c.created_time createdTime from ai_workbook_commit c join ai_workbook w on w.workbook_id=c.workbook_id where c.workbook_id=#{workbookId} and w.user_id=#{userId} order by c.commit_no desc
mapper.insert: insert into ai_workbook_commit (commit_id, workbook_id, branch_id, parent_commit_id, second_parent_id, commit_no, commit_message, source, author_user_id, author_name, operation_id, action_schema_version, planned_actions_json, executed_changes_json, inverse_changes_json, diff_summary_json, knowledge_refs_json, data_context_json, execution_context_json, before_hash, after_hash, validation_json, snapshot_id, created_time) values (#{commitId}, #{workbookId}, #{branchId}, #{parentCommitId}, #{secondParentId}, #{commitNo}, #{commitMessage}, #{source}, #{authorUserId}, #{authorName}, #{operationId}, #{actionSchemaVersion}, #{plannedActionsJson}, #{executedChangesJson}, #{inverseChangesJson}, #{diffSummaryJson}, #{knowledgeRefsJson}, #{dataContextJson}, #{executionContextJson}, #{beforeHash}, #{afterHash}, #{validationJson}, #{snapshotId}, now(3))

insert into ai_workbook_snapshot (snapshot_id, workbook_id, commit_id, snapshot_type, content_blob, content_hash, codec, created_time) values (#{snapshotId}, #{workbookId}, #{commitId}, #{snapshotType}, #{content}, #{contentHash}, 'plain', now(3))
mapper.select: select s.snapshot_id snapshotId, s.workbook_id workbookId, s.commit_id commitId, s.snapshot_type snapshotType, cast(s.content_blob as char character set utf8mb4) content, s.content_hash contentHash, s.codec, s.created_time createdTime from ai_workbook_snapshot s join ai_workbook w on w.workbook_id=s.workbook_id where s.workbook_id=#{workbookId} and s.commit_id=#{commitId} and w.user_id=#{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into ai_workbook_working_state (workbook_id, branch_id, owner_user_id, base_commit_id, draft_actions_json, executed_changes_json, draft_snapshot, content_hash, version, update_time) values (#{workbookId}, #{branchId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{baseCommitId}, #{draftActionsJson}, #{executedChangesJson}, #{content}, #{contentHash}, 0, now(3)) on duplicate key update base_commit_id=values(base_commit_id), draft_actions_json=values(draft_actions_json), executed_changes_json=values(executed_changes_json), draft_snapshot=values(draft_snapshot), content_hash=values(content_hash), version=version+1, update_time=now(3)
mapper.select: select workbook_id workbookId, branch_id branchId, owner_user_id ownerUserId, base_commit_id baseCommitId, draft_actions_json draftActionsJson, executed_changes_json executedChangesJson, cast(draft_snapshot as char character set utf8mb4) content, content_hash contentHash, version, update_time updateTime from ai_workbook_working_state where workbook_id=#{workbookId} and branch_id=#{branchId} and owner_user_id=#{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from ai_workbook_working_state where workbook_id=#{workbookId} and branch_id=#{branchId} and owner_user_id=#{userId}
